metadata.usage: The whole-mesh part-choice overview exposes anonymous SAMPart3D regions in full-tool context as one multi-view sheet with colored part overlays for function-region selection. Isolated cards are auxiliary debug views. Mainline functional-face cards are generated after part-role selection and expose declared bbox faces as F markers for the selected part on a multi-view whole-mesh sheet. The executable candidate.points.* anchor and normal axis are derived from the selected face. Precomputed all-part face cards are debug-only and must not be used for executable axis binding unless explicitly allowed. Mainline function-axis binding is derived from the selected F marker's surface ref. Marker tables map VLM selections to exact refs.
